review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–120) and judged it only against the repeated-proof-machinery rubric. A shared lemma would need a statement for each of the two cases and would save very little, so it would be a thin wrapper that doesn't meet the rubric's bar. `trace_algHom`, `algHom_star` and `norm_algHom` are short, distinct calculations.
